# 2 Kings 7 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Kings 7 (20 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.1 — Hebrew measurement units vs. modern equivalents
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "a seah of fine flour" / **PNEUMA:** "six quarts of fine flour"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "a seah" — retain the Hebrew unit; modern conversion introduces false precision.

---

## V.2 — "windows in heaven" vs. "floodgates in the sky"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "windows in heaven" / **PNEUMA:** "floodgates in the sky"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "windows in heaven" — *arubbot* means windows/lattice openings, preserving the Genesis 7:11 echo.

---

## V.4 — "we shall but die" vs. "we were going to die anyway"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "we shall but die" / **PNEUMA:** "we were going to die anyway"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "we shall but die" — preserves the solemn resignation of the Hebrew.

---

## V.13 — Treatment of a textually difficult verse
- **EMET:** Preserves repetition / **LOGOS:** Smoothed / **PNEUMA:** Heavily paraphrased
- **SOPHIA ruling:** Follow LOGOS — smooth the repetition while preserving the essential argument.

---
*— SOPHIA*
